records.finding: The PR introduced a bundled multi-id title convention in CONTRIBUTING.md and commit-lint.sh but left .github/pull_request_template.md ('The id that authorises this change', singular) and .warden/skills-policy.md Shipping ('the tracked item id', 'type: summary (bead-id)') stating the old single-id contract — one standard in two disagreeing wordings (charter item 8, ADR-0008).
records.evidence: cross-examiner read both files at the round-1 head: neither mentioned the bundled form this diff enforces
records.reason: Both files updated in the same PR: the template now names the space-separated multi-id form, and the policy's Shipping section points at CONTRIBUTING for the bundled spelling. Scoped re-review verdict: addressed.

records.finding: The new multi-id alternation accepted duplicate ids — '(workspace-abc workspace-abc)' passed — because ERE has no backreference; CONTRIBUTING's 'lists every id it closes' implies distinct ids, and no test case covered repetition.
records.evidence: grep -Ex against the new pattern matched the duplicate-id header verbatim (reviewer command output)
records.reason: Post-match shell dedupe over the parens group (sed extract, tr/sort/uniq -d) rejects duplicates with a named error; three new test cases (duplicate pair, duplicate among three with squash suffix, dotted-sibling distinct pass) watched failing before the fix. Scoped re-review verdict: addressed.

records.finding: The new 'ci-go.sh: MODE under ROOT' stderr line lands at the tail of each check's captured output_tail in .warden/out verify artifacts, after the check's real concluding output.
records.evidence: verify-result.json output_tail fields end with the diagnostic for all six modes despite the echo executing before the module loop
records.reason: Cross-examiner REJECTED: the placement is the capture layer concatenating stdout-then-stderr, not a script defect; every other ci-go.sh diagnostic deliberately uses stderr and the check verdict is driven by exit_code, so switching this one line to stdout would break the script's own convention to work around an external rendering quirk.
